summary.text: Aaron Holley is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 22 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Patrick Morrisey appointed him on July 9, 2026, to replace Daniel Linville, and he took office on July 28, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Aaron Holley lives in Ona, West Virginia, and his career experience includes working with CSX Corporation.
Linville resigned from the House on June 28, 2026.
Holley defeated Linville in the May 12, 2026, Republican primary for District 22, 650 votes to 647.
